mapper.insert: insert into consent_record (member_id, doc_type, doc_version, scene, scope_type, scope_id, event_type, occurred_at, request_id, ip_address, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{docType}, #{docVersion}, #{scene}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAt}, #{requestId}, #{ipAddress}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from consent_record where member_id=#{memberId} and request_id=#{requestId}

select id, member_id, doc_type, doc_version, scene, scope_type, scope_id, event_type, occurred_at, request_id, ip_address, create_time from consent_record where request_id = #{requestId} lock in share mode
mapper.sql: select * from consent_record where member_id=#{memberId} and doc_type='privacy_policy' and scene='roam_location' and scope_type is null and scope_id is null order by id desc limit 1
select * from consent_record where member_id=#{memberId} and doc_type='privacy_policy' and scene=#{scene} and scope_type is null and scope_id is null order by id desc limit 1
mapper.select: select c.* from consent_record c join roam_presence_revoke_intent e on e.request_id=c.request_id and e.member_id=c.member_id and e.event_type=c.event_type where c.member_id=#{memberId} and c.doc_type='privacy_policy' and c.scene='roam_presence' and c.scope_type is null and c.scope_id is null and e.id=(select max(latest.id) from roam_presence_revoke_intent latest where latest.member_id=#{memberId}) order by e.id desc limit 1

select id, member_id, doc_type, doc_version, scene, scope_type, scope_id, event_type, occurred_at, request_id, ip_address, create_time from consent_record where member_id = #{memberId} and doc_type = #{docType} and scene = #{scene} and scope_type is null and scope_id is null order by occurred_at desc, id desc limit 1

select id, member_id, doc_type, doc_version, scene, scope_type, scope_id, event_type, occurred_at, request_id, ip_address, create_time from consent_record where member_id = #{memberId} and doc_type = #{docType} and scene = #{scene} and scope_type = #{scopeType} and scope_id = #{scopeId} order by occurred_at desc, id desc limit 1
